title: Sketch-based Secure Query Processing for Streaming Data

statements.text: The size of the GK sketch when running with parameter 𝑠 is at most 2𝑠 ln( 𝑛𝑠 + 2) + 2 when the stream length is 𝑛.
All eligible pairs can be fused within ⌈log 𝑠 ′ ⌉ rounds of compression.

After a merge operation, there are 𝑠 ′ new tuples in the sketch. In the worst case, these newly inserted tuples are consecutive where all 𝑠 ′ − 1 pairs satisfy the fusion condition. However, due to the constraint that no two overlapping pairs can be fused simultaneously (since each tuple can participate in at most one fusion per round), we can fuse at most ⌊𝑠 ′ /2⌋ pairs in the first round. Furthermore, these 𝑠 ′ − 1 pairs can be fused into one single tuple when the fusing threshold 𝑛/𝑠 is greater than 𝑠 ′ . After the first round we have at most ⌈𝑠 ′ /2⌉ remaining tuples that could be fused, and similarly ⌈𝑠 ′ /4⌉ after the second round, and so on. Therefore, at most ⌈log 𝑠 ′ ⌉ rounds are required to complete all eligible fusions in the worst case. □
